Package org.clafer.cli

package org.clafer.cli
  • Class
    Description
    Frontend
    Reads a .cfr model that is not an explicit model: with the Java frontend (ToIr, then ToAst) in this JVM, or, when the Java frontend cannot take the model, with the Haskell compiler (clafer -k -m choco), whose .js file is read with Rhino.
    Frontend.ModelException
    A model that cannot be read.

    REPL
    clafersg's REPL for a static model: the Choco backend of the one solution loop (Repl), with clafersg's commands and messages, and the instances as chocosolver prints them.
